analysis:
This batch contains only test-file changes.

DistributedInstalledCancellationTests.swift (head 9, 15, 18, 25-26) and DistributedInstalledLanesTests.swift (head 17-24, 52-53) now expect Gemma4 tensor-parallel to accept explicit batch lanes 2-8, retired alone (lanesRetireAlone true), with a singleton default of 1. They also expect a new Plan.tensorParallelLaneAdapters map: GLM5 maps to 8 and Gemma4 maps to 1. These tests imply production changes in DistributedInstalledPlan, which is not supplied in this batch.

Integration should verify the following for the production change:
- Lane isolation per request (cancellation/retirement per lane) for Gemma4 tensor-parallel.
- That private images remain excluded from lanes.
- No cross-request KV or prefix sharing beyond the coordinator-authored cacheSalt scope (T-041/SEC-035, A-001).
- No cross-lane plaintext leakage (TB-007, T-028).

InstalledSessionCheck.swift head 978-1345 is unchanged surrounding test code; its changed ranges (301-333 and 828-843) are in other units. The patch excerpt shows the relay test now binding an OS-assigned ephemeral loopback port instead of a cluster-range port. That is a test-only change with no production attack surface.

The visible checks cover:
- Serving grants refusing unknown models and foreign artifacts.
- Adapter environment values not overriding fixed keys.
- Mixed-install refusal.
- Stop-bound behavior.
- Quarantine on a missing release ACK.
- Sanitizing control characters out of refusal reasons (line 1249).

No regression is evident from test code alone. Production source for the Gemma TP lanes is outside this batch, so it needs review.
